preconditions.description: The length of numbers a and b must be between 2 and 100000.
Both numbers a and b must be valid n-digit numbers.
The lengths of a and b must be equal to n.

postconditions.description: If it is impossible to transform a into b, output -1.
The number of coins c must be the minimal number of operations, and the output must contain at most 100000 moves.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= d_i <= n - 1 and s_i in {1, -1} for d_i, s_i in moves)
postconditions.description: Each move must specify a valid digit position and a valid operation.
